humanizer-ko:humanizer-ko: 한국어 텍스트에서 AI 생성 글의 티를 찾아 제거한다. 글을 자연스러운 사람의 문장으로 다듬거나 검토할 때 사용. Remove signs of AI-generated writing from Korean text (humanize Korean text). 의의 부풀리기, 홍보성 언어, 연결어미 부가절, AI 어휘, 이중 피동, 번역투, 문체 혼용, 삼분법, 줄표 남용, 상투적 마무리 등 35개 패턴을 탐지하고 고친다.

humanizer:humanizer: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line closers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, sales language, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing."
r0/humanizer/SKILL.md

imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.
r2/imagegen/SKILL.md

japanese-humanizer: AI文、またはAI風に見える翻訳調の日本語を、意味を保ったまま人に自然に読める文体へ整えるときに使う。機械的な均質さ、冗長表現、係り受けの不自然さ、総論的な締めをほどき、必要に応じて変更理由を説明する。一般的な校正や翻訳品質評価ではなく、AI文を自然な日本語へ整えることを主目的にする。AI検出器回避、出自判定、偽装目的では使わない。翻訳、要約、事実確認、根拠追加が主目的の依頼では主スキルにせず、必要なら最終文体調整として補助的に使う。
